entities.name: Protocol configuration options
entities.description: This IE is included in messages when the network wishes to transmit protocol data to the UE, such as configuration parameters, error codes, or messages/events.

entities.name: Extended protocol configuration options not supported
entities.description: Condition where either the UE does not support extended protocol configuration options or the network does not support end-to-end extended PCO for the PDN connection.

entities.name: Network transmits protocol data to UE
entities.description: Network behavior of transmitting protocol data such as configuration parameters, error codes, or messages/events to the UE.

relations.description: The network's desire to transmit protocol data to the UE establishes the inclusion of the PCO IE in the message.
The inclusion of the PCO IE is guarded by the condition that extended protocol configuration options are not supported.
